Guests (11): Lucia Haddad, Hector Zielinski, Andre Haddad, Maeve Oyelaran, Fatima Xu, Valentina Cho, + advising office, registrar rep, IT liaison, two student reps

Hi all!

So finally the Compass initiative is starting, thank you everyone for agree to be part. I know many of you have different idea what Compass should be exactly, and honestly this is the point of meeting — we sit together and make it more clear what we are trying to do for the students and who is doing which part.

I don't want to make a heavy agenda, more I want we talk openly. Some things I am hoping we cover, but we will see where conversation goes:
- what problem we really solving (Lucia and Fatima have little different view, both good)
- what we can do in this semester vs later
- who take care of which piece

Please come with your opinions, even strong ones, is better to argue now than in May haha. The student reps especially, please speak, we need your voice more than ours.

I will bring coffee and some snacks from the bakery on corner. If you cannot come in person the Meet link is fine but camera on please if possible, is easier for discussion.

Thanks and see you!
Cyrus
